This document is a README for **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack. Here are its key technical points:

## Models & Quantization
- **GLM-5.3-Flash**: Multiple quant options (Maya-L/Maya-S/Maya-XS, EXL3 2.9–4.10 bpw, unsloth GGUFs). Sizes range ~100 GB (Maya-S) to ~520 GB (unsloth Q8). Maya's own quants use 2–3 bit experts with ~92.6% next-token agreement with the original.
